method: Native first-stage simple-policy victories and actual five random rewards. For each held inventory, adapt 15 fixed full-collection recipes to earned copies, fill with starter and deduplicate compositions. Include starter. Choose using three independent simulated training battles (one per prep); validate on held-out seeds with fixed deck across prep/final. Builder never sees actual stage2 shuffle. Same earned inventory/seed across unchanged vs adaptive. Includes mixed decks with more than2 attributes after legal fallback. No exchanges, no human/browser test, no optimality claim; selection policy is more intensive than typical human play and only three samples.
